title: Skip Dali's Old Town — Locals Ride 130 km Around the Lake | China Travel Expert
description:
Everyone pours into Dali's old town. The locals' move? Rent a bike and ride the lake.

Dali Ancient Town is free to enter now — and wall-to-wall with tour groups. The better day (or two) is a loop around Erhai Lake: about 130 km of water, mountains and Bai villages the buses skip. Rent a bike from around 20 yuan, follow the shore, and stop in Xizhou for tie-dye and 5-yuan baba bread. Ride the calmer east side and you'll have whole stretches almost to yourself.

🧭 Expert Tip: Ride Erhai's quiet east shore instead of the busy west-side Haixi highway — same lake, a fraction of the traffic. Two unhurried days beats one crowded afternoon in the old town.
